description: Declarative World Cast & Hubs Layer for Clean-Slate Night City. Compiled by tools/build-clean-slate.py into mod\neon_ascendancy\cast_and_hubs.questphase and wired off ascendancy.questphase. Populates gated district hub crowds, spawns all 7 fixers and 10 iconic hub/faction residents at their canonical locations with their required workspot prefabs (zero vanilla gigs/SMS/holocalls/quests, ready for Neon Ascendancy overhaul systems), and enables all clean service vendors/bartenders/ripperdocs without setting forbidden story-completion facts.

keep_alive_pause.why: Never set during normal play; keeps cast_and_hubs.questphase alive for the entire save so its phasePrefabs and questSpawnSet activations are never released.
